# Bundled Tesseract language data

These gzip-compressed language models are bundled so English and Simplified
Chinese scanned-PDF OCR works offline in packaged desktop builds.

- `eng.traineddata.gz` — SHA-256 `45B4CB346724AC1774F1C36F42F182B887BCDB28EBE63E6FFF90AC41F3FCFF91`
- `chi_sim.traineddata.gz` — SHA-256 `B8A23F10C7DE500891EB458A8ADC9CC58AB7F242F08B7D149F5E9AEA4AD5DB7C`

Source: Tesseract `tessdata_best` 4.0.0 language data, Apache-2.0.
